items.title: SAG-AFTRA, WGA & AFM Warn Of "Harms" Of Unlicensed AI Training
items.headline: SAG-AFTRA, WGA & AFM Warn Of "Harms" Of Unlicensed AI Training
items.excerpt: SAG-AFTRA, the WGA and the AFM filed a brief asking a federal judge to reject a fair-use exemption for AI training in the OpenAI copyright case, warning of the 'harms of unlicensed training' for performers and writers.
items.rationale: A new court filing: Hollywood's three main guilds jointly ask a federal judge to reject fair use for AI training in the OpenAI case. It bears directly on how studio-side AI tools can be trained.

items.title: AI Vocal Modifier Voicemod Inks Disney Deal to Add Star Wars, Marvel Soundboards to Platform
items.headline: AI Vocal Modifier Voicemod Inks Disney Deal to Add Star Wars, Marvel Soundboards to Platform
items.excerpt: AI voice-modifier platform Voicemod signed a Disney licensing deal to add official Star Wars and Marvel character voices and sound effects for creators and gamers.
items.rationale: A concrete licensing deal: Disney puts official Star Wars and Marvel voices and sound effects into an AI voice tool. It is a template for licensed rather than scraped franchise IP.

items.title: ‘Iron Man’ Cinematographer Matthew Libatique Says AI ‘Could Replace Marvel’ VFX, but They’ll Never ‘Use AI Actors’
items.headline: ‘Iron Man’ Cinematographer Matthew Libatique Says AI ‘Could Replace Marvel’ VFX, but They’ll Never ‘Use AI Actors’
items.excerpt: Cinematographer Matthew Libatique says he is testing AI tools for Darren Aronofsky's next project and that AI 'could replace' Marvel-style VFX work, while insisting studios will never use AI actors.
items.rationale: A top cinematographer says he is actively testing AI tools on Aronofsky's next film. Firsthand craft view on where AI lands (VFX) and where it doesn't (actors).

items.title: The NEW Lighting Workflow Changing Filmmaking (Full AI Tutorial)
items.headline: The NEW Lighting Workflow Changing Filmmaking (Full AI Tutorial)
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge walks through a new AI relighting workflow for film footage, showing how generative tools can re-light shots in post.
items.rationale: The most actionable item in the pool: a step-by-step AI relighting workflow for footage in post, from a whitelisted channel.

items.title: "3분 액션신에 2억 절감"…AI로 제작비 아끼고 창작 영역 확장
items.headline: "3분 액션신에 2억 절감"…AI로 제작비 아끼고 창작 영역 확장
items.excerpt: [AI 만난 방송가 ②] 생성형 AI가 자막·음성 변환을 넘어 액션신·CG 제작에 쓰이며 3분 액션신에서 2억 원을 절감하는 등 국내 드라마·예능 제작비와 창작 영역을 바꾸고 있다.
items.rationale: Concrete Korean production numbers (KRW 200M saved on a 3-minute action scene) on generative AI in drama and variety-show VFX. Adds a Korean outlet to the mix.
